classification_rules.EARLY_OBSERVABLE: Features computed solely from telemetry available at or before the 24h screening decision cutoff (0h baseline and 24h early burn-in). Fully authorized for early inference.
classification_rules.FUTURE_GROUND_TRUTH: Telemetry and measurements recorded at t > 24h (e.g., 48h, 96h, 168h). STRICTLY FORBIDDEN as predictive model inputs; used exclusively for retrospective ground truth verification.
classification_rules.IDENTIFIER: Unique entity identifiers (component_id, die_id, test_id). STRICTLY FORBIDDEN as predictive features to prevent memorization artifacts.
classification_rules.METADATA: Manufacturing batch and fabrication hierarchy metadata (lot_id, wafer_id, manufacturer, package, component_type, equipment_id). Used strictly for disjoint group-splitting and stratified analysis; not direct raw predictive features.
classification_rules.TARGET: Ground truth labels and derived target columns (latent_168h_failure, trajectory_state, state_24h, state_168h, result). STRICTLY FORBIDDEN in feature matrices.
classification_rules.FORBIDDEN_LEAKAGE: Any feature or derived column containing temporal tokens ('168', 'future', 'post_burn_in', 'ground_truth', 'state_168h', 'target') when presented to an early-screening model.
